name: Custom Shape Wooden Pencil Topper
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood for a sturdy, durable, and lightweight finish.
    - Crafted from 3mm wooden material for a solid and neat display.
    - Smooth printed surface helps showcase bright colors and clear details.
    - Lightweight design makes it suitable for everyday pencil use without adding too much weight.
    - Comes with a pencil topper ring insert for stable attachment.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 sizes:
          +) 1.5 x 1.5 in ~ 3.81 x 3.81 cm
          +) 2 x 2 in ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm
    - Pencil topper ring size:
          +) Width: 1.1 cm ~ 0.43 in
          +) Height: 1.2 cm ~ 0.47 in
          +) Inner opening: 0.8 cm ~ 0.32 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - One-sided printing on the wooden front surface.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a fun and decorative pencil topper for everyday use.
    - Fits on standard pencils to add a personalized and playful touch.
    - Great for classroom use, school supplies, homework time, and desk decoration.
    - Lightweight construction helps keep the pencil comfortable to hold and use.
    - Can be used as a small personalized accessory for students, teachers, and stationery lovers.
    - Ideal for decorating pencils in classrooms, offices, study desks, and art spaces.
    - Works well as a themed school accessory for back-to-school season, teacher appreciation, and classroom rewards.
    - Easy to attach and remove when needed.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Great gift for teachers, students, classmates, and school staff.
    - Perfect for back-to-school, teacher appreciation, and classroom rewards.
    - Suitable for birthdays, holidays, and small personalized gifts.
    - A fun gift choice for stationery lovers and school-themed collections.
    - Ideal for custom name gifts, teacher-themed gifts, and classroom party favors.
    - A thoughtful keepsake that is both decorative and practical.

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Pencil Topper

 

PRODUCTION

NOTE

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
